title: Implement ingest.py: ROM parsing with PSPTool
description:
Create src/psp_etl/ingest.py implementing:
- ingest_rom(rom_path, db, data_dir) function per DESIGN.md
- PSPTool integration: iterate roms -> directories -> files
- Extract body bytes (try get_decrypted_decompressed_body first, fall back to get_bytes)
- Content-address blobs to data/blobs/{sha256}.bin
- Populate entries table with all metadata (zen_generation, type_id, version, etc.)
- Catch PSPTool exceptions per-ROM, log to parse_errors table
- classify_by_agesa() helper for zen generation classification
- Depends on: db.py

comments.author: driver
comments.content: Design decision: Unit tests mock PSPTool API objects (ROM, Directory, File). Integration tests use real ROMs from data/roms/ with a pytest marker to skip when absent.
